intent: A record book being rewritten live: the table, the stadium, then the clock on how long each man held it.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Who has scored the MOST World Cup goals ever?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Who has scored the most World Cup goals ever?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Mbappé. 22 World Cup goals for France, and he is still only 27.

lines.direction: pull back over the Atlantic; the table slides in row by row — Mbappé's red bar on top, Messi one short; the football sticker drops on 'walked'
lines.text: Messi finished on 21. Klose had 16, Ronaldo 15. Mbappé went past them all in 2026.

lines.direction: fly across the ocean to Miami; the stadium pin on 'Miami', the date tag; on 'goals' a counter ticks to 10 — his tournament total — the bronze sticker on 'lost', because the record came in a defeat
lines.text: The record fell in Miami, in the third-place game against England: a brace, in a match France actually lost.

lines.direction: back out wide; a THEN/NOW split — 12 YEARS for Klose on the left, 1 MONTH for Messi on the right; hourglass sticker on 'month'; the sad Argentine flag-ball
lines.text: Klose had held it for 12 years. Messi took it in June. It lasted about a month.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
